title: Foreign funds help make housing unaffordable: research
summary: University of Texas McCombs research analyzes how foreign investment contributes to housing unaffordability, examining the impact of international capital flows on residential real estate markets and pricing dynamics.
problem_solved: Investigates the relationship between foreign capital inflows and residential housing prices for policymakers and market participants.
why_valuable: Provides empirical evidence linking foreign investment to housing affordability challenges, offering insights for housing policy and urban planning decisions.
